news.title: Working With Penguins or Players, Coach Makes Each Moment Count
news.summary_en: Women's assistant lacrosse coach Jennifer Douglas is an Advanced Animal Care Specialist with the Water’s Edge team at the Kansas City Zoo & Aquarium and her passion is serving as one of the point persons for 85 penguins.

news.title: First Rockhurst Trip to Bologna Center Opens Eyes to Global Health
